content: {"phoneNote":"The hero works, but the signpost labels (Raduha, Logarska dolina, Smučišče) repeat as the 'Poti in cilji' list further down, and the rooms section is a long plain text column with no photos.","desktopNote":"Hero is strong and specific, but every section below is text-only, left-aligned in a narrow column with the right half of the page empty (rooms, prices, Poti/Pot do nas).","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Add photos of the rooms, apartment and weekend meals in the Sobe/Apartma and Izletniška kmetija sections; on desktop place them in the empty right column.","Drop the duplicated destinations: keep the hero signposts as links and remove the separate Raduha/Logarska/Smučišče list, or merge 'Pot do nas' with the address block.","Fill the desktop width: rooms and apartment side by side with images, prices across the full width, and one contact section instead of phone and email repeated in footer."],"blockers":[]}
